issues.desc: background.md ## Solution Tradeoffs and checklist CHK-002/CHK-003 promise four responsibility components and three ordered implementation Stories, but never preserve their exact names or responsibility mapping. A fresh reader cannot recover the already-decided decomposition without the missing conversation; name the four components (Finding Ledger Integrity; Candidate & Defect Identity; Dynamic Applicability; Freshness & Supersession) and the three follow-up Stories with their owned problem classes.
